name: Basic Training
description: Fundamental adventuring drills. +6 Max HP and +1 Accuracy per level.

name: First Aid
description: Patch up wounds, restoring a small amount of HP.

name: Bash
description: A powerful strike. Higher levels can stun the target.

name: Provoke
description: Taunts the target and nearby monsters, forcing them to attack you.

name: Shield Guard
description: Brace behind your guard, greatly increasing defense.

name: Sword Mastery
description: Weapon discipline. +4 Physical Attack and +1 Accuracy per level.

name: Spiral Pierce
description: A spinning thrust that pierces armor and knocks the target back.

name: War Cry
description: A rallying shout that raises the attack of you and nearby allies.

name: Counter Attack
description: Enter a counter stance: chance to strike back whenever hit in melee.

name: Blade Storm
description: ULTIMATE. Spin into a storm of steel, striking all nearby foes three times.

name: Double Shot
description: Loose two arrows at once.

name: Arrow Rain
description: Rain arrows on an area, striking every enemy inside.

name: Falcon Strike
description: Your falcon dives at the target. Never misses.

name: Wind Trap
description: Set a whirling wind trap that damages and slows enemies passing over it.

name: Eagle Eye
description: Sharpened sight. +2 Accuracy, +1 Critical and +8 attack range per level.

name: Rapid Fire
description: Fire arrows in rapid succession, increasing attack speed.

name: Camouflage
description: Blend into the surroundings. Monsters lose track of you until you attack.

name: Piercing Arrow
description: ULTIMATE. A charged arrow that pierces through every enemy in a line.

name: Fire Bolt
description: Hurl a bolt of fire. Strong against earth.

name: Ice Bolt
description: A shard of ice that can freeze the target. Strong against fire.

name: Lightning Bolt
description: Call lightning onto the target. Strong against water.

name: Fire Wall
description: Ignite the ground. Enemies standing in the flames are burned repeatedly.

name: Frost Nova
description: Release a burst of frost around you that can freeze enemies in place.

name: Thunderstorm
description: Summon a storm that strikes an area three times.

name: Meteor
description: ULTIMATE. Call down falling stars that devastate a wide area and stun.

name: Mana Shield
description: A barrier of mana absorbs part of incoming damage using MP instead of HP.

name: Astral Attunement
description: Your mind resonates with the Astral Runes. +3 Magic Attack, +2 MP regeneration and -1% cast time per level.

name: Holy Light
description: A lance of dawnlight. Holy magic damage — devastating against the undead.

name: Heal
description: Restore HP. Scales strongly with INT and skill level.

name: Benediction
description: A blessing: +1 STR, INT and DEX per level.

name: Swift Grace
description: Lightens the step: +3 AGI (+1 per level), +5% attack speed and +20% move speed.

name: Aegis Hymn
description: A hymn of warding: +5% DEF per level.

name: Purify
description: Cleanse poison, blindness, silence and curses.

name: Sacred Ward
description: +1 DEF and 3% less damage from the undead per level.

name: Smite Evil
description: +1 ATK and +3% damage against the undead per level.

name: Sanctum Nova
description: ULTIMATE. Consecrate the ground: holy light strikes everything inside again and again.

name: Twin Fang
description: With a dagger, each basic attack has a 5% chance per level to strike twice. Also +1 HIT per level.

name: Evasion Instinct
description: +3 FLEE per level.

name: Pilfer
description: Try to steal an item from a monster's loot. Chance rises with DEX and skill level. One success per monster; bosses can't be robbed.

name: Shadow Veil
description: Vanish into shadow: monsters lose you until you attack. Movement is slowed.

name: Venom Edge
description: A poisoned strike. Poison-element damage that can poison the target.

name: Grit Toss
description: Throw a fistful of sand: earth damage that can blind.

name: Knife Throw
description: Hurl a throwing knife at range.

name: Antidote
description: Neutralise poison.

name: Hundred Cuts
description: ULTIMATE. Eight lightning-fast dagger cuts; may stun.

name: Pack Mule
description: +200 carrying capacity per level.

name: Haggle
description: NPC shop prices −2.4% per level (max 24%).

name: Silver Tongue
description: NPCs pay 2.4% more per level when you sell (max 24%).

name: Coin Strike
description: Hit with the weight of your purse. Costs Luma: 100 + 100 per level.

name: Cart Sweep
description: Swing your trade cart: hits everything around the target and knocks it back.

name: Market Shout
description: A rousing sales pitch: +4 STR and +4% ATK for 5 minutes.

name: Steady Grip
description: Hard work: +3 ATK and +1 HIT per level.

name: Golden Ruin
description: ULTIMATE. Pour a fortune into one blow. Costs Luma: 500 + 250 per level.

name: Drake Riding
description: Ride a war-drake: +4% move speed and +60 carry weight per level.

name: Lance Mastery
description: +5 ATK, +1 HIT and +1% damage to Large foes per level.

name: Impale
description: A charging lance thrust that ignores part of the target's DEF.

name: Drake Sweep
description: Wheel the drake around: spear sweep that hits everything nearby and knocks it back.

name: War Banner
description: Raise the banner: +3% ATK and +2% attack speed per level.

name: Iron Hide
description: Brace behind your armor: +8% DEF and +4% max HP per level.

name: Skewer Line
description: Drive the lance through a whole line of enemies.

name: Sky Dive
description: ULTIMATE. The drake leaps and crashes down: huge damage in an area, stunning foes.

name: Faith
description: +3% max HP, +2 MDEF and 3% holy resist per level.

name: Holy Bulwark
description: Lift your shield: 4% chance per level to block with a counter, +5% DEF per level.

name: Shield Bash
description: Slam your shield into the foe: may stun.

name: Sacred Strike
description: A holy weapon strike.

name: Devotion Aura
description: An aura of devotion: +2% max HP and +1 HP regen per level.

name: Judgement Cross
description: A blazing cross of light around you: holy damage to everything nearby.

name: Provoking Vow
description: Draw every foe nearby to you.

name: Heaven's Shield
description: ULTIMATE. For a short time, a wall of light: +40% DEF, +20% max HP and immunity-like holy resist.

name: Falcon Bond
description: Your falcon grows stronger: +2 DEX and +1 CRIT per level.

name: Blitz Falcon
description: The falcon dives: damage that always hits, ignoring FLEE.

name: Snare Trap
description: Set a trap that roots and wounds foes stepping in.

name: Blast Trap
description: A trap that explodes in fire.

name: Beast Bane
description: +4 ATK and +3% damage to beasts and insects per level.

name: Keen Senses
description: +10 HIT and +3% attack speed per level.

name: Tri Shot
description: Three arrows at once.

name: Falcon Storm
description: ULTIMATE. Your falcon calls its flock: a storm of talons over an area.

name: Music Lessons
description: +5 ATK, +2 MATK and +1% attack speed per level.

name: Song of Haste
description: +4% attack speed and −2% cast time per level.

name: Song of Vigor
description: +4% max HP and +2 HP regen per level.

name: Song of Fortune
description: +2 CRIT and +2 perfect dodge per level.

name: Discord
description: A grating chord: magic damage to nearby foes, and it may put them to sleep.

name: Melody Strike
description: An arrow or chord that rings in the target's ears: may silence.

name: Lullaby
description: A drowsy melody fills an area: monsters fall asleep.

name: Grand Finale
description: ULTIMATE. The last chord: heavy magic damage all around you and +15% ATK/MATK for a minute.

name: Arcane Focus
description: +4 MATK and −1% cast time per level.

name: Frost Gale
description: A freezing gale over an area: water damage, may freeze.

name: Crimson Sky
description: Lightning rains from a red sky.

name: Earth Spikes
description: Stone spikes erupt from the ground.

name: Ice Wall
description: A wall of ice that freezes and chills anything inside it.

name: Flame Ring
description: A ring of fire bursts out around you.

name: Mana Well
description: +3 MP regen and +2% MATK per level.

name: Meteor Storm
description: ULTIMATE. A rain of meteors over a wide area; may stun and burn.

name: Study
description: +3 ATK with books, +3 MATK and +1% attack speed per level.

name: Endow Fire
description: Your weapon becomes fire (5 minutes + 1 per level).

name: Endow Water
description: Your weapon becomes water.

name: Endow Wind
description: Your weapon becomes wind.

name: Endow Earth
description: Your weapon becomes earth.

name: Double Cast
description: −6% cast time and −3% cooldowns per level.

name: Stone Volley
description: A volley of earth spikes at one target.

name: Cataclysm
description: ULTIMATE. Four elements crash down at once: fire, water, wind and earth strikes in an area.

name: Greater Heal
description: A large heal.

name: Kyrie Shield
description: A shield of prayer: 20% (+3%/lv) of damage goes to MP and +5% DEF per level.

name: Holy Mastery
description: +3 MATK and +2% holy damage per level.

name: Magnificat
description: Doubles your MP regeneration for a while.

name: Lex Divina
description: Silence a foe with holy law.

name: Turn Undead
description: Huge holy damage against a single target, best against the undead.

name: Sanctuary
description: Holy light around you heals you and burns the enemies nearby.

name: Magnus Judgement
description: ULTIMATE. A great cross of holy fire burns everything in it.

name: Iron Fist
description: +4 ATK and +1 FLEE per level.

name: Spirit Spheres
description: Summon spirit spheres: +3 ATK and +1% attack speed per level.

name: Triple Blow
description: A quick three-hit combo.

name: Chain Combo
description: Four hits that follow a Triple Blow.

name: Steel Body
description: Harden the body: +60% DEF, −30% move speed.

name: Ki Explosion
description: Release ki around you, stunning nearby foes.

name: Snap Step
description: Light feet: +20% move speed and +3 perfect dodge.

name: Asura Strike
description: ULTIMATE. Pour all your spirit into a single blow that ignores DEF.

name: Katar Mastery
description: +4 ATK and +1 CRIT per level.

name: Cloak of Shadows
description: Move unseen; monsters lose you until you attack.

name: Sonic Blade
description: Eight lightning-fast katar slashes; may stun.

name: Venom Spray
description: Spray poison on the target: poison damage, likely poisons.

name: Enchant Poison
description: Coat your blade: weapon becomes poison.

name: Grimtooth
description: A katar wave at range that hits around the target.

name: Lethal Focus
description: +5% crit damage and +2 CRIT per level.

name: Soul Reap
description: ULTIMATE. Appear behind the target and cut through its soul; ignores half its DEF.

name: Snatch
description: A better steal: higher chance than Pilfer.

name: Mug
description: Hit the target and pocket Luma: monster level × (skill level × 3 + LUK / 10), once per monster.

name: Strip Armor
description: Rip at the target's gear: may curse it (−25% ATK, slower).

name: Backstab
description: A brutal stab that never misses.

name: Tunnel Drive
description: Move while hidden.

name: Vulture Eye
description: +1 HIT and +6 bow range per level.

name: Rain of Knives
description: Throw a fan of knives or arrows over an area.

name: Grand Heist
description: ULTIMATE. A blinding raid: heavy damage, steals an item and blinds the target.

name: Smithing
description: Practised hands: +3 ATK and +2 DEX per level, and +1% forging success per level.

name: Adrenaline Rush
description: +5% attack speed per level.

name: Power Thrust
description: +5% ATK per level.

name: Weapon Perfection
description: Ignore size penalties: +12% damage to every size per level.

name: Hammerfall
description: Slam the ground: stuns everything nearby.

name: Skin Tempering
description: +4% fire and +1% neutral resist per level.

name: Cart Crash
description: Ram your loaded cart into the target. Costs Luma.

name: Meltdown
description: ULTIMATE. Forge-fire in the veins: +25% ATK, +20% attack speed and fire weapon.

name: Potion Research
description: Know-how: +3% max HP, +2% max MP and +1 HP regen per level.

name: Acid Terror
description: Throw acid: ignores DEF and may cause bleeding.

name: Bomb Flask
description: A fire flask that burns the ground.

name: Chemical Shield
description: Coat your armor: +6% DEF and 3% resist to every element per level.

name: Aid Potion
description: Throw a healing potion at yourself.

name: Bioethics
description: The secret of artificial life. Required to create a homunculus.

name: Acid Rain
description: Acid falls over an area.

name: Acid Bomb
description: ULTIMATE. Acid and fire together: huge damage that ignores DEF, twice.

name: Dragon Fury
description: TRANSCENDENT. +20% ATK and +15% attack speed, but −20% DEF.

name: Wyrm Spiral
description: TRANSCENDENT. A spiralling dragon-lance that hits five times.

name: Martyr's Grace
description: TRANSCENDENT. 30% of damage taken goes to MP instead, +10% DEF.

name: Divine Lance
description: TRANSCENDENT. A spear of light from the sky.

name: Wolf Pack
description: TRANSCENDENT. Spirit wolves maul the target six times.

name: True Sight
description: TRANSCENDENT. +5 all stats, +10% CRIT damage, +20 attack range.

name: Symphony
description: TRANSCENDENT. Every song at once: +10% attack speed, +10% max HP, +5 CRIT.

name: Sonic Wave
description: TRANSCENDENT. A shock of sound through a line of enemies.

name: Mystic Amplify
description: TRANSCENDENT. +30% MATK for a short time.

name: Soul Vulcan
description: TRANSCENDENT. Ghost-element blasts that strike five times.

name: Endow Holy
description: TRANSCENDENT. Your weapon becomes holy.

name: Foresight
description: TRANSCENDENT. −40% cast time for a short time.

name: Assumptio
description: TRANSCENDENT. Halve incoming damage for a short time (+50% DEF, +30% MDEF-like resist).

name: Meditatio
description: TRANSCENDENT. +2% max MP, +1 MP regen and +4% heal power (MATK) per level.

name: Tiger Cannon
description: TRANSCENDENT. A crushing palm strike that knocks the target back.

name: Mountain Root
description: TRANSCENDENT. +20% max HP and 20% counter chance.

name: Meteor Assault
description: TRANSCENDENT. A blur of blades around you; may blind and stun.

name: Deadly Venom
description: TRANSCENDENT. +30% ATK and poison weapon for a short time.

name: Full Strip
description: TRANSCENDENT. Strip everything: curse, blind and slow the target.

name: Shadow Bounce
description: TRANSCENDENT. Blades bounce between foes near the target.

name: Maximum Power
description: TRANSCENDENT. +50 CRIT damage and +30% ATK for a short time.

name: Cart Termination
description: TRANSCENDENT. The cart, the Luma and the hammer in one blow. Costs a lot of Luma.

name: Full Protection
description: TRANSCENDENT. +20% DEF and +10% max HP for a long time.

name: Elixir Rain
description: TRANSCENDENT. Drink and spill elixir: big heal and +10% MATK.
